levels.title: Turn the corner onto safe footing
notes: E is an idle, one-use training enemy. It becomes blue and remains in place. The firing mark (3,6,0) is in the enemy region, on the same neutral area.
From that one safe firing mark, shoot blue A through matching red W, then shoot W to recover red. Cross the northbound red span and pass the now-blue wall to the green exit.

The 3 m-high normal corner is mandatory collision geometry, not decorative cover: it blocks entry-bank and first-span shots toward both A and W. Purple entry and green exit markers in the top view are annotations, not gameplay colors.
levels.lesson: Shoot the red enemy, cross west to its neutral area, then turn 90 degrees toward the exit. The solid corner hides A and W until this left-side approach.

notes: The lower passage is roofed by the upper neutral slab. Its muzzle plane is below the blue platform; only flat footing at 0 m and +4 m permits firing, and neither muzzle plane intersects the slab. Falling is intentional and nonlethal here.
levels.lesson: Cross blue footing first; exchange from neutral ground, then deliberately step through the blue slab to the lower route. Climb back behind the obstruction.
